column1: # WHOOP API v2: vendor fields to LOINC 2.83
# WHOOP API v2 schema fields. WHOOP reports energy in kilojoules and deep sleep as slow-wave sleep.
#   type        the vendor's data type, record class or endpoint, verbatim
#   field       the field inside it, verbatim; empty when the type is the reading
#   metric      the mirobody catalogue name (res/catalog/metrics.tsv); empty when the catalogue has no row
#   loinc       the LOINC code the field means; EMPTY IS A DECLINE, and the note says why
#   confidence  confident = the six LOINC axes agree with the vendor's definition;
#               unverified = close, a person must confirm before a reading is filed under it
#   note        the reasoning; some notes are in Chinese, as they were written
# Every code was checked by hand against the LOINC 2.83 axis table on 2026-09-09.
# No vendor API carries a LOINC code of its own. LOINC is copyright Regenstrief
# Generated from the maintainers' review tables; edit through a pull request,
# and keep the file loadable by mirobody.translate.devices.
